messages:
laura_sales: Kicking off Selene POC. Need a hosted API key for embeddings+chat only, short TTL and IP lock. Can infra provision today?

 tom_se: Yep. Which IPs and exact scopes? Also they'd like a billing tag.

 laura_sales: IPs: 52.23.112.0/24 and 3.120.45.9. Scopes: embeddings.create, chat.generate. Tag: selene_poc_may. TTL requested: 72h auto-rotate. Quota: 3M tokens/day.

 rachel_infra: I can do that. Two clarifications: model whitelist?

 laura_sales: Model: rwd-embed-1 (embeddings) and rwd-gpt-small-v3 (chat). No streaming. Require header `X-Customer: selene`.

 nora_security: Security checks: no console admin perms, KMS logging enabled, require header enforced at gateway, and rotation overlap 2 minutes for POC.

 rachel_infra: I'll provision with policy:
```
scopes: ["embeddings.create","chat.generate"]
models: ["rwd-embed-1","rwd-gpt-small-v3"]
allowlist_ips: ["52.23.112.0/24","3.120.45.9"]
tag: "selene_poc_may"
quota: "3000000/day"
ttl: "72h"
rotation: "auto_issue_new_then_revoke"
streaming_allowed: false
required_headers: ["X-Customer: selene"]
```
Will post secret to secure-vault link.

 redwood-bot: infra: key-meta created id=k_9b1c4d7e status=active

 rachel_infra: Created key k_9b1c4d7e; secure-vault: https://secure.redwood.internal/vault/selene-k_9b1c4d7e (expires in 72h)

 tom_se: Added runbook note for sales:
- find key: Console -> API Keys filter tag=selene_poc_may
- revoke: Console or POST /v1/keys/k_9b1c4d7e/revoke
- on-demand rotation: tag ops + run POST /internal/keys/rotate?k=k_9b1c4d7e&mode=issue_new_then_revoke&overlap=2m

 laura_sales: Thx team. I'll send to customer and confirm they can handle rotation pulls. Closing for now.

 rachel_infra: Marking resolved. Will monitor audit logs for KMS events.
